variants.name: needs を [ ] の並びで書く・deploy の並びを替える

parallel:
name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
  unit:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
  lint:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
  e2e:
    needs: [build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run e2e
  deploy:
    needs: [e2e]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run deploy
deploy:
name: ci

      - run: npm test

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
  e2e:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

parallel:

name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
  unit:
    needs:
      - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
  lint:
    needs:
      - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
  e2e:
    needs:
      - build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run e2e
  deploy:
    needs:
      - unit
      - lint
      - e2e
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm run deploy
